Capgemini: Multi-agent AI moves into banking and insurance, but orchestration remains limited
items.snippet: Financial institutions are struggling to scale multi-agent AI beyond pilot projects, with just 10% of banks and insurers having achieved enterprise-wide orchestration despite 59% piloting or deploying the technology, according to Capgemini research.

items.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
items.snippet: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.

items.title: Most Brits not ready to let AI manage their money
